notes: Reached www.interiordefine.com directly with curl_cffi (CloudFront AAAA host) - no proxy needed; r.jina.ai was serving a Cloudflare interstitial this session and was not required. robots.txt names no Anthropic/Claude agent and does not disallow category paths. The storefront is a Magento PWA Studio SPA: every category URL returns HTTP 200 but the same 9,017-byte empty-#root shell with no <title> and no rendered listing header (WebFetch also returned no content), so brief method 1 is genuinely unobtainable. All counts therefore come from method 2 - the site's own Magento GraphQL endpoint /graphql, which is the exact data source the PLP renders from. TREE: BFS over categoryList(filters:{parent_id:{eq:X}}) starting at root id 2, walked to full depth; cross-checked with a categoryList(ids:{in:[...]}) sweep of ids 200-899. COUNTS: products(filter:{category_id:{eq:X}},pageSize:1).total_count, read TWICE for every one of the 44 leaves - all pairs agreed, no drift. Every leaf URL validated with urlResolver, which returned type CATEGORY with the matching category id for all of them. SANITY: counts vary per category (no site-wide constant), no round display caps, and leaf totals matched the independent categoryList product_count field exactly on every spot check. Parent/anchor product_count is NOT reliable here - it returned different values depending on query form (Living 589 via parent_id vs 938 via ids:{in:}), and children sums exceed some parents because a product can sit in several shape categories; that is why no parent was ever recorded as a leaf. All parents are grouping rows. EXCLUDED per brief: Rugs (94, textiles), Lighting (16), Decor (Artwork 86 / Pillows 21 / Made to order pillows 12 / Mirrors 0 / Throws 0), bedroom/all-beds/mattresses (0), the inactive bedroom/all-bedding tree (duvet covers, sheet sets, blankets & throws, bedding essentials), and the promo/navigation buckets In Stock, Full In Stock List, Just in, New Arrivals, Best Sellers, Shop The Catalog, Trade Favorites, Warehouse Sale plus the ~15 named designer 'collection' pages (Alexander, Asher, Beckham, Caitlin, Dixon, Fiona, Hayes, Hayley, Lee, Oslo, Rose, Saylor, Scarlett, Sydney, Riva Outdoor). DROPPED: Dining > All dining seating > 'Dining Chairs & Stools' (id 597, 56 products) - urlResolver returns null for its path so it has no reachable PLP URL, and its total is exactly its two siblings summed (37 + 19), i.e. a union node. Outdoor (id 521) is a level-2 department with no children; its 14 items are outdoor sofas and sectionals (Riva/Scout/Dunes/Jasper Outdoor), verified by listing product names, so it is recorded as a furniture leaf. 'All benches' (Living) and 'All sideboards' (Dining) are the site's own leaf node names, not shop-all links: they have no children and hold real product sets (benches; sideboards Lena/Warner/Mayes/Beale/Barnes/Elton/Farris), verified by listing product names. Two node names repeat on different live URLs with different totals (Modular sectionals 307/322, Modular sofas 312/323) - both kept and flagged per brief. Dressers and Desks are live categories currently holding 0 products.
